dynasty.bounty.acquire_wheat.title: Acquire - Wheat
dynasty.bounty.acquire_wheat.desc: Hand in 16 wheat. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used; armour, offhand and curios are untouched, and nothing is taken unless the full amount is present.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_carrot.title: Acquire - Carrots
dynasty.bounty.acquire_carrot.desc: Hand in 16 carrots. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used; nothing is taken unless the full amount is present.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_potato.title: Acquire - Potatoes
dynasty.bounty.acquire_potato.desc: Hand in 16 potatoes. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used; nothing is taken unless the full amount is present.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_brown_mushroom.de: Hand in 12 brown mushrooms. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_string.title: Acquire - String
dynasty.bounty.acquire_string.desc: Hand in 16 string. Spiders and cave spiders drop it; only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_leather.title: Acquire - Leather
dynasty.bounty.acquire_leather.desc: Hand in 8 leather. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_paper.title: Acquire - Paper
dynasty.bounty.acquire_paper.desc: Hand in 16 paper, crafted from sugar cane. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_bamboo.title: Acquire - Bamboo
dynasty.bounty.acquire_bamboo.desc: Hand in 16 bamboo from jungles or panda areas. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_cobblestone.title: Acquire - Cobblestone
dynasty.bounty.acquire_cobblestone.desc: Hand in 32 cobblestone, a common mining by-product. Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.acquire_logs.title: Acquire - Logs
dynasty.bounty.acquire_logs.desc: Hand in 32 logs of any type (matched by the vanilla logs tag). Only your main inventory and hotbar are used.
dynasty.bounty.hunt_zombie.title: Hunt - Zombies
dynasty.bounty.hunt_zombie.desc: Kill 8 zombies yourself after accepting. Only your own kills count (including arrows you fired); pet kills, environmental deaths and other players' kills do not.
dynasty.bounty.hunt_skeleton.title: Hunt - Skeletons
dynasty.bounty.hunt_skeleton.desc: Kill 8 skeletons yourself after accepting. Only your own kills count (including your arrows); pets and environmental deaths do not.
dynasty.bounty.hunt_spider.title: Hunt - Spiders
dynasty.bounty.hunt_spider.desc: Kill 6 spiders yourself after accepting. Kills made before accepting are never counted retroactively.
dynasty.bounty.hunt_creeper.title: Hunt - Creepers
dynasty.bounty.hunt_creeper.desc: Kill 4 creepers yourself after accepting. Only your own kills count (including your arrows); pets and other players do not.
dynasty.bounty.explore_celestial.title: Survey - Celestial Dynasty
dynasty.bounty.explore_celestial.desc: Enter the Celestial Dynasty yourself after accepting. If you are already inside when you accept, it completes on the next server check (about 2 seconds).
dynasty.bounty.explore_underworld.title: Survey - Underworld
dynasty.bounty.explore_underworld.desc: Enter the Underworld yourself after accepting. If you are already inside, it completes on the next server check (about 2 seconds).
dynasty.bounty.explore_jiuxiao.title: Survey - Nine-Heaven Realm
dynasty.bounty.explore_jiuxiao.desc: Enter the Nine-Heaven Realm yourself after accepting. Requires the 'Reach the Nine Heavens' advancement first, otherwise this offer stays locked.
dynasty.bounty.explore_dragon_palace.des: Enter the Dragon Palace yourself after accepting. Requires the 'Into the Dragon Palace' advancement first; bring water breathing.

tooltip.dynasty.school.zhenyue_blade: Main-hand use: guard up to 2s, block 50% of front-facing blockable damage; 6s cooldown after guarding. Blocking a hostile stores one +35% full-strength blade hit for 3s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.zhenguan_mirror: +4 armour. Guard damage +1.6% per toughness point (max +200%); Mountain-Ward counter window extends to 6s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.huben_bracer: +15% knockback resistance, +12% Guard damage; counters push mobs away or slow bosses I for 2s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.liuyun_sword: Land three full-strength melee hits on one enemy within 3s between hits; the third deals +50% and resets the chain. Weak hits, target changes or weapon swaps reset it.
tooltip.dynasty.school.liancheng_tassel: +6% attack speed, +16% Sword damage; Flowing-Cloud chain window extends to 5s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.tayun_pendant: +4% speed, +12% Sword damage; Flowing-Cloud finishers grant Swift Wind I for 2s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.zhuxing_bow: Arrow base damage ×2+30. A fully drawn hit marks one enemy for 8s; a second fully drawn hit on it consumes the mark for +40% damage. Hitting another enemy replaces the mark; no homing or wall piercing.
tooltip.dynasty.school.guanxing_pendant: +40 health, +10% Bow damage (+25% against glowing targets); Star-Chasing marks make targets glow for 3s.
tooltip.dynasty.school.mingxian_ring: +3 armour, +12% Bow damage; consuming a mark slows I for 2s (1s on bosses).
tooltip.dynasty.school.chiling_brush: Main-hand use: slow up to 8 visible hostiles within 5 blocks, II for 3s (bosses I for 1s); 8s cooldown. Hold still while using for 2s to store one +50% full-strength brush hit for 4s. Moving or releasing early cancels charging.
tooltip.dynasty.school.sitian_seal: +40 health, +25% Edict damage; Edict slow lasts 2s longer (1s on bosses).
tooltip.dynasty.school.dingfeng_silk: +3 armour, +15% Edict damage; stationary Edict charging adds 50% knockback resistance. Damage bonus does not require charging.
message.dynasty.school.guard_ready: Counter ready: next full-strength Mountain-Ward hit +35%
message.dynasty.school.star_marked: Star mark: land another fully drawn shot within 8s
message.dynasty.school.edict_cast: Edict cast: hold use and stand still for 2s
message.dynasty.school.edict_ready: Edict ready: next full-strength brush hit +50% within 4s

infusion.dynasty.effect.dragon_scale.des: Heavy hostile hits grant 4 absorption for 3s; 12s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.dragon_crystal.d: Every second charged hit on one target adds 12% damage and slows; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.refined_steel.de: Charged hits on armored enemies add 10% damage and 1s weakness; 5s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.xuanwu_shell.des: Blocking in the first 8 ticks grants 3s resistance; 10s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.qinglong_scale.d: Charged hits on enemies below half health grant 2s speed and jump; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.baihu_fang.descr: Charged critical melee hits add 15% damage and knockback; 6s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.zhuque_feather.d: Fire damage extinguishes you and grants 3s fire resistance; 12s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.taiyi_jade.descr: Falls beyond 3 blocks deal half damage; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.ink_stick.descri: Equipped: talisman spell hits grant 3s resistance; 10s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.talisman_paper.d: Equipped: talisman spell hits restore 2 food points; 12s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.heavy_stagger.de: Every third charged melee hit slows and interrupts non-boss enemies; 6s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.last_stand.descr: Hostile hits below 30% health deal 25% less damage and grant absorption; 12s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.night_soul.descr: Charged hits at night or in the Underworld reveal and weaken; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.backstrike.descr: Charged melee hits from behind weaken and slow for 2s; 6s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.poison_ward.desc: Hostile hits cleanse existing poison and slowness; 10s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.hunter_mark.desc: Fully charged arrows beyond 8 blocks reveal for 5s and grant 2s speed; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.retaliation.desc: Heavy hostile hits knock back non-boss attackers and weaken for 1s; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.lifebloom.descri: Heavy hostile hits grant 3s regeneration; 12s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.soul_siphon.desc: Charged undead hits at night or in the Underworld apply wither; 10s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.sunpurge.descrip: Charged daytime undead hits ignite for 2s and cleanse your poison; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.wither_ward.desc: Undead hits cleanse existing wither and weakness; 10s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.air_step.descrip: Charged airborne melee grants 3s slow falling and knocks back non-bosses; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.venom.descriptio: Every second charged hit poisons non-undead enemies for 3s; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.water_ward.descr: Hostile hits underwater grant 5s water breathing and dolphins grace; 10s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.parry_cleanse.de: Blocking in the first 8 ticks cleanses poison, weakness and slowness; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.effect.storm_call.descr: Charged hits during thunderstorms weaken and slow for 2s; 8s cooldown.
infusion.dynasty.select_hint: Click to select for replacement or removal; click again for automatic placement.
infusion.dynasty.apply_cost: Costs 2 materials and 3 XP levels. Replaced materials are not returned.
infusion.dynasty.remove_cost: Removal costs 1 XP level; no material refund.
infusion.dynasty.error.10: Slots full; select a crest to replace
message.dynasty.dungeon.poison_warning: Corpse venom is rising. Leave the pit!
message.dynasty.dungeon.mercury_warning: Spectral mercury burns. Reach a platform or copper bridge!
book.dynasty.chensha.diary.1:
Chensha Notes I
Break all three entry seals.
Smoking floor tiles warn of a trap. An old ladder on the east side of the pit returns to the gallery.
book.dynasty.chensha.diary.2:
Chensha Notes II
Copper bridges cross the spectral mercury.
The trial seals its doors: shoot all three beast eyes within sixty seconds. A failed attempt permits retreat and keeps eye progress.
book.dynasty.chensha.diary.3:
Chensha Notes III
Cracked bricks behind the southeast mercury fall conceal the artisans’ burial room.
Break the blank stele with a pickaxe to unlock the return lift.
message.dynasty.dungeon.coffin.sealed: The coffin is sealed. Defeat this tomb’s Zhaoming Emperor first.
message.dynasty.dungeon.coffin.missing_d: The encounter or its rewards are unavailable. The seal and reward records are preserved.
message.dynasty.dungeon.coffin.ineligibl: Only surviving participants of this tomb’s encounter may claim rewards.
message.dynasty.dungeon.coffin.inventory: Inventory full. Remaining rewards are saved; make room and claim again.
message.dynasty.dungeon.coffin.already_c: All available rewards have been claimed. The world reward is granted only once.
message.dynasty.event.official_document: Army safe passage lasts 10 minutes; attacking a soldier revokes it.
message.dynasty.cod4.swindler_injured: Traveler, my leg is injured. One copper coin for this rare medicine.
message.dynasty.cod4.swindler_suspect: The medicine is only dead wood. Hold it and sneak-interact to expose the fraud.
message.dynasty.cod4.swindler_exposed: Fraud exposed! The swindler flees; defeat him to recover the stolen coin.
message.dynasty.cod4.guide: Guide incense: ruin %s, about %s blocks away, %s seconds remaining
message.dynasty.cod4.guide_expired: Guide incense has burned out; the ruin marker fades.
cod3.dynasty.dialogue.special: Discuss the item in your hand
cod3.dynasty.npc.lao_chen.special: Hold that blueprint steady. Study its lines before choosing the materials; brute strength alone never made a fine weapon.
cod3.dynasty.npc.han_chong.special: Record every name on that bamboo slip. No frontier wind can erase the names of our brothers.
cod3.dynasty.npc.baibao_jin.special: Old coins have their own stories! If you mean to trade, let us open the packs and take our time.
message.dynasty.cod4.bellows_needs_furna: Place smeltable input in a furnace within three blocks, then work the bellows. Full fires or blocked output do not consume charcoal.
infusion.dynasty.effect.cold_ward.descri: Worn leather: 20% less freezing damage and 8 fewer frozen ticks each second. Stops immediately when removed.
message.dynasty.cod4.well_released: The dark mist fades and the restless spirit is released. An old jade remains by the well.
message.dynasty.cod4.puzzle_clue: Lock clue: face %s and %s before pressing the pin.
message.dynasty.cod4.puzzle_reset: Wrong direction. Pins reset: face %s and %s to start again.
message.dynasty.cod4.puzzle_open: The four pins align. The interlocking lock opens and delivers its blueprint.
message.dynasty.cod4.mortuary_clue: A faint chest movement reveals a living person. After observing, offer a healing potion. Milk can still cleanse you.
message.dynasty.cod4.mortuary_space: Clear a safe place beside the mortuary slab first.
message.dynasty.cod4.mortuary_rescued: The breath steadies. The living patient is rescued and delivers the heirloom sword.
cod4.dynasty.ghost_boat.first: Incense lights the way. Will you ask about this crossing?
cod4.dynasty.ghost_boat.talk: TALK · Ask about the ghost-market crossing
cod4.dynasty.ghost_boat.asked: The route is recorded on an old bamboo slip. Once the incense has burned for two minutes, hold one Cinnabar, reopen the boat and choose delivery. You may browse my goods meanwhile.
cod4.dynasty.ghost_boat.deliver: DELIVER · Give one Cinnabar for the old bamboo slip
cod4.dynasty.ghost_boat.done: The cinnabar is received and the bamboo slip is yours. Return after one day to deliver again; crossing coins are granted only once. My goods remain available.
cod4.dynasty.ghost_boat.return: Your incense is burning at another boat. Return there to finish the agreement.
cod4.dynasty.ghost_boat.space: The boatman needs nearby clear standing space with a floor. Your incense has not been consumed.
cod4.dynasty.poison_tea.first: An unsigned tea stall. The old man grins and offers you a cup.
cod4.dynasty.poison_tea.inspect: Inspect the tea, stall and vendor
cod4.dynasty.poison_tea.inspected: A rainbow film coats the tea. The stall has no sign, and the vendor only grins. Watch for two minutes, then overturn the table to expose the poison.
cod4.dynasty.poison_tea.flip: Overturn the table and expose the poison
cod4.dynasty.poison_tea.poisoned: The tea is poisoned! Poison lasts twenty seconds; milk still cures it.
cod4.dynasty.poison_tea.revealed: The table tips, spilling the oily tea. The vendor steps away. Original secret 19 is solved.
cod4.dynasty.poison_tea.space: The tea vendor needs nearby clear standing space with a floor.
cod4.dynasty.sword_dance.step_0: First form: face north, step half a block east, then briefly swing your main-hand sword in the air. Follow the moonlit footprint and original forty-second timing.
cod4.dynasty.sword_dance.step_1: Second form: face north, step half a block west, then swing in the air after the original forty-second interval.
cod4.dynasty.sword_dance.step_2: Third form: step half a block north, face east, then swing in the air after the original forty-second interval.
cod4.dynasty.sword_dance.reset: The step or cut missed the sword shadow. Begin with the first form; original investigation and claimed rewards remain.
cod4.dynasty.sword_dance.found: Three forms match the moonlit shadow. Original secret 28 is discovered.
